# `kernel/execution/WorkspaceRevisionRepository.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/execution/WorkspaceRevisionRepository.js`

Browser-native workspace revision authority. This deliberately implements the useful trust properties of a small Git subset without invoking Git: immutable lossless blobs, trees and commits, named refs, exact compare-and-swap, and verified readback. Blob bodies live only in the encrypted app-private object store. Provider, Graph, Dossier and status projections expose canonical paths, hashes, revisions and sizes, never the stored source bodies.

### `workspaceRevisionPrivateWriteBytes({ key, expectedRevision, value } = {})`

Conservative durable-byte charge for one member of the single atomic AppSandbox publication batch. AppSandbox persists an AES-GCM record as hexadecimal ciphertext and mirrors the authenticated envelope into its files-visible readback. The fixed allowance covers the record envelope, inventory page, generation heads, readback key page, and bounded JSON framing. Charging both encrypted copies is deliberately conservative; source bytes never enter the meter receipt.

### `createWorkspaceRevisionSandboxAdapter(sandbox, { resourceMeter = null } = {})`

Exact-key encrypted AppSandbox adapter. It never lists records and performs every mutation against the opaque version token returned by the same key.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
